news.title: “Students are talking”: NUS president warns moving goalposts are costing Brand UK
news.summary_en: International students are sharing their experiences of refusals and changing rules, and the UK's reputation is paying the price, warns Favour Samuel, the first international student to lead the National Union of Students (NUS) England.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Irish universities face €8m fee shortfall after student visa refusals
news.summary_en: Ireland’s Labour Party wants a review of student visa refusals as one university warns of cuts to master’s courses and the Department of Justice says its application criteria are unchanged.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Hong Kong takes three of Asia’s top five places in QS university rankings
news.summary_en: Singapore’s two leading universities slipped out of Asia’s top five, 16 Malaysian institutions reached their highest ranks yet and India’s representation in the top 200 rose from 20 universities to 21.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Going Global Istanbul to spotlight HE resilience and global partnerships
news.summary_en: Education leaders from around the world are coming together for three days in Istanbul to discuss the future of higher and further education in Türkiye, Central Asia, and the South Caucasus.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: Federal court scraps Trump’s four-year limit on international students’ stays
news.summary_en: The US District Court for the District of Massachusetts has ruled in favour of a coalition challenging the Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) final rule ending the Duration of Status policy for international students, exchange visitors and representatives of foreign media.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: IDP rejects sweetened bid from private equity giant Blackstone
news.summary_en: IDP Education has turned down another offer from Blackstone, arguing that the bid does not adequately reflect the company's value and would only serve as a "distraction" for its board.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Tighter compliance not tactic to manage international student numbers, says UK Home Office
news.summary_en: There is no blanket policy to manage the number of international students coming to the UK through visa refusals or tighter compliance policies, the Home Office has insisted.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: US: Total number of international students drops for first time in five years
news.summary_en: While the United States remains the top destination for international students globally, new student enrolments have continued to fall in 2025/26, with a record 18% decline shown by newly released data.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: Brazil’s K-12 sector calls for closer collaboration
news.summary_en: International education professionals at the inaugural PIE High Brazil called for stronger collaboration among schools, education agents, independent advisers and government-linked organisations – with students’ interests at the centre of the study-abroad journey.
news.author: Beth Kennedy
